newsitem.title: USA: Praxair to sell Statia Terminals for $210 million.
newsitem.headline: Praxair to sell Statia Terminals for $210 million.

text.p: Praxair Inc. said Wednesday it entered into a definitive agreement to sell Statia Terminals Inc. to a new company formed by Castle Harlan Partners II, L.P. and the management of Statia Terminals for $210 million.
Statia Terminals provides storage, bunkering and related services for petroleum and other products in the Netherlands Antilles, Nova Scotia, Canada and Texas.
Praxair, which is the nation's largest maker of industrial gases, said it acquired Statia Terminals in March when it bought CBI Industries. It previously announced plans to sell the unit.
Castle Harlan Partners II, a unit of Castle Harlan Inc., a New York-based merchant banking firm, specialises in acquisitions.
Praxair said the proceeds of the sale would be used to pay down debt related to the CBI acquisition.
It said the sale is expected to be completed by the end of the year.
Praxair was off 12.5 cents at $43 on the New York Stock Exchange.
